title.en: Looking at the Lingering Snow on Zhongnan

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource (from Three Hundred Tang Poems).
edition.zh: 据维基文库（《唐诗三百首》本）。

basis.en: Tang dynasty poem; the author died around 746.
basis.zh: 唐诗，作者约卒于 746 年。

note.en: Written as an examination poem, which by the rules should have run to twelve lines; Zu Yong handed in four, and when asked why, said the meaning was complete. The story is in the Tang anecdote collections, and the poem bears it out: snow on the far mountain, a little brightness after the clouds, and the city below feeling colder for it.
note.zh: 这是一首应试诗，按规矩应写十二句，祖咏只写了四句就交卷，有人问他，他说：“意尽。”这个故事见于唐人笔记，诗本身也证明了他：远山积雪，云开后林梢一片明亮，山下的城里反而更冷了。

excerpt.orig: 林表明霽色，城中增暮寒。
excerpt.en: At the edge of the woods the clearing sky is bright; / in the city the evening cold grows deeper.
excerpt.zh: 林表明霁色，城中增暮寒。

gloss.en: The Zhongnan Mountains, south of Chang’an.
gloss.zh: 终南：终南山，在长安城南。

gloss.en: The north face of the ridges, the side seen from the city, where the snow lingers.
gloss.zh: 阴岭：山的北面。从长安望去，见到的正是终南山的北坡，积雪不化。

gloss.en: The tops of the trees, the edge of the woods.
The light of the sky clearing after snow.
gloss.zh: 霁色：雨雪停后天空放晴的光色。

gloss.en: Zu Yong wrote this for the civil examination, which required twelve lines. He handed in four, and when asked why, said the meaning was complete.
gloss.zh: 据《唐诗纪事》，此诗是祖咏应试之作，按规定应写六韵十二句，他只写四句便交卷，问其故，答曰“意尽”。

note.en: A four-line examination poem whose author said the meaning was complete, and it is; a fine, cool miniature rather than a great one.
note.zh: 应试只写四句，作者说“意尽”，果然意尽；一幅清冷精致的小品，而非巨制。
